caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow plate or bowl shown from two perspectives: a front view occupying most of the center and a side profile above it. The primary object is a circular dish with a reddish-brown base color, decorated with swirling yellow lines and patches across its surface, which appear to be a painted or glazed design. The rim of the plate features a textured or beaded edge in a darker shade. The accompanying side profile view at the top shows the same reddish-brown color and hints of the yellow decoration along the rim. The background is neutral, with the composition set inside a lightly sketched rectangular frame. The artist's name, Gertrude Lemberg, is written at the bottom right corner.
title: Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
